children: A year after Anglo American's $54 bln merger with its Canadian rival the pair are still waiting for Chinese approval. Antitrust issues are minimal and investors remain confident, but Beijing has extracted concessions before. Mining megadeals are becoming costlier everywhere.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Yawen Chen on Bluesky and LinkedIn.

EU regulators are preparing to warn Hong Kong-listed mining and metals company MMG ​over its plan to buy Anglo American's Brazilian nickel business because of competition concerns, Reuters reported on September 8, citing three people familiar with the matter.
China’s review for Anglo American's proposed acquisition of Teck Resources remains suspended, Mergermarket reported on September 1.

“We are not going to provide a running commentary but we are working with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through its normal process and, as we have said all along, this transaction is positive for supply growth and therefore also for our customers,” Anglo American told Reuters Breakingviews on September 7.
Teck told Reuters Breakingviews the company does not comment on regulatory processes.
Anglo American has previously said it expects the Teck merger to close between September 2026 and March 2027.
